case_title: Sukhjit Singh v. State of Punjab
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 364 IPC and sentenced to 10 years RI and fine of Rs.5000
neutral_facts: The prosecution alleged that the accused took his wife with the intention to end her life. The victim's mother testified that the victim was in Central Jail and was unaware of the year she remained there. Documents Exts. DA and DB supported her statement. None of the witnesses mentioned abduction. The accused claimed the victim was in custody under Section 302 IPC and provided documents to prove this. The trial court accepted the mother's testimony and video evidence of the marriage, concluding the accused was the husband and thus responsible for the victim's disappearance. The High Court upheld this decision.
